projects.name: GRIID Infrastructure, Inc. acquisition (Tennessee facilities)
projects.quote: We have also had a hosting arrangement with GRIID Infrastructure, Inc. to host up to 54 MW of our bitcoin miners in Tennessee, which hosting arrangement terminated when we closed on our acquisition of GRIID Infrastructure, Inc. on October 30, 2024, and the 54 MW continued as our owned and operated facilities.

projects.name: Massena, NY hosting arrangement
projects.quote: We have an independent data center operation in Massena, NY that hosts 50 MW for us, which agreement will terminate on January 1, 2025.
